base:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW ORIGINAL COARSE PIXEL-ART WEBSITE BANNER. Widescreen 3:1, 1536x512 output but ART MUST LOOK LIKE A NATIVE 384x128 PIXEL GAME SCENE enlarged 4x using nearest neighbor. Every tiny feature is a LARGE CLEAR SQUARE PIXEL, roughly 4x4 output pixels. This is an anime-inspired cozy low-resolution internet pixel world, NOT a realistic painted architecture illustration. Think simple 16-bit background / deliberately chunky toy-like pixel silhouettes, FLAT untextured surfaces, VERY LIMITED 16-24 color palette, no fine detail, no noisy dithering, no micro-texture, no photorealism, no complex painterly shading. Prioritize style and atmosphere over precise architecture. No characters required.
COMPOSITION: generous dark quiet LEFT 45% for later website headline; on RIGHT HALF small simplified Cornell Baker Laboratory and its attached modern Physical Sciences Building. Baker: long low grey stone rectangular silhouette, raised FLAT central parapet, central entrance with 4 tall simple pale rectangular columns, two rows of a FEW small windows, climbing ivy only as a few chunky dark green blocks. Adjacent PSB at far RIGHT: slightly taller simple box of dark teal glass with a few broad pale-cyan horizontal/vertical grid bars. Make the distinctive historic stone + modern glass contrast recognizable with the FEWEST pixels possible. Buildings about 45 native pixels tall, no detailed masonry, not a mansion or castle, no sloped/chateau roofs. Slightly oblique view across a small dark lawn and curved path. A few chunky stepped foliage tree silhouettes at edges, trees do not hide central columns.
MOOD: midnight, very dark blue-green sky blending with a dark personal website, soft cyan crescent moon and sparse large cross-shaped stars. Warm golden little window rectangles, muted teal reflected on glass, subtle lavender dusk line low on horizon. Cozy mysterious anime pixel-art atmosphere. Most of the picture dark (#0d1c21 to #20343a); warm accents restrained, not bright daylight. Flat pixel cloud clusters. No text, labels, logos, UI, frames or watermark. No photograph conversion. Make a beautifully simple small scene, not a grand detailed panorama.
summer-dawn:
Use case: lighting-weather. Edit this original COARSE anime-inspired pixel-art banner, preserving EXACT simple geometry, dark negative space on LEFT 45%, Baker's simple 4-column stone facade on RIGHT beside the boxy cyan-grid PSB, native low pixel scale, placement of buildings, tree trunks and moon. DO NOT ADD DETAIL. It must still look like 384x128 logical pixels enlarged 4x, with huge square pixel clusters, simple flat shape shading, only 16-24 colors, zero fine masonry or detailed realistic foliage. No painterly texture or smooth gradients. Beauty and consistency of low-resolution game art are more important than realism. No text, no labels, one scene not a montage. Keep same 3:1 dimensions.
 Change atmosphere/foliage only: BEFORE SUNRISE in summer: keep the scene mostly dark navy-teal with deep green trees, a very restrained muted violet/rose band low on the horizon. Stars and crescent still visible, warm windows. NOT a bright pink or blue daytime sky.
